# Foil Battery Rental

> Unofficial community map at https://foilbattery.com where foil assist and eFoil riders borrow a battery at their holiday destination from locals, foil schools and rentals. Foil assist batteries are lithium-ion packs that airlines do not allow on board, so riders travel without one and borrow on site.

- Travellers search a destination, filter by brand (Foil Drive, Manta Foils, RIIFT, Duotone, Flow Customs, Flite, Waydoo and others) and battery model, log in and contact the lender via WhatsApp or email.
- Lenders are private owners or schools / rentals. Every listing is reviewed by hand before it appears on the map.
- Price, deposit, handover and payment are agreed directly between rider and lender. The site is free, takes no fees and handles no payments.
- Operated by Ola Vibes S.L., El Médano, Tenerife, Spain. Contact: mail@foilbattery.com. Not affiliated with any manufacturer.
